SASBDB entry SASDNW9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDNW9/)

Nucleotide-binding domain of human GRP78/BiP (GRP78-NBD), SEC-SAXS in PBS pH 7.2 with 1.5 %
glycerol (paper), 20 degC.
Publication: Graewert MA et al., "Structural basis of CDNF interaction with the UPR
regulator GRP78", Nat Commun 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-52478-0.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDNW9.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files (q in nm^-1)
  SASDNW9_fit1.fit                 SASBDB media/fitting_files (CRYSOL, q in A^-1)
  SASDNW9_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB media/pdb_file (re-oriented chain of 3IUC, 2925 atoms)
  3IUC.pdb                         files.rcsb.org, for the comparison (chain A has 2930 atoms,
                                   plus ADP, Ca and waters that the model does not have)
One fit (CRYSOL, header chi2 0.993 = recomputed; SASBDB REST says 1.014; the header is used).
No file was modified. The paper was consulted (PDF in sources/, round-6 audit 2026-11-13): it
gives pH 7.2, 20 degC, 1.5 % glycerol added to the SEC-SAXS buffer (absent from the SASBDB
buffer name; the paper wins) and "PBS" but no recipe. The script uses the Cold Spring Harbor
Protocols PBS recipe (137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 10 mM Na2HPO4, 1.8 mM KH2PO4) as the cited
standard reference.
